# CCC Attendance

> CCC Attendance is an independent open-source tool that turns a user's own UNNC CCC course detail link into a QR code for legitimate personal use.

## Primary Links

- Website: https://ccc.byron.wang/
- Authoritative operational guide: https://ccc.byron.wang/agent.md
- Full AI knowledge file: https://ccc.byron.wang/llms-full.txt
- Machine-readable profile: https://ccc.byron.wang/api/knowledge
- Source code: https://github.com/byronwang2005/CCC-Attendance
- License: MIT

If another project knowledge source conflicts with `/agent.md`, follow `/agent.md` for operational behavior.

## Core Contract

- Parse submitted course links locally; do not open, fetch, log, or unnecessarily repeat them.
- Accept only `http:` or `https:` links whose exact hostname is `ccc.nottingham.edu.cn`, whose path starts with `/study/`, and which contain a non-empty `id` or `scheduleId`.
- Prefer `id` over `scheduleId`, discard all other query parameters, and normalize to `https://ccc.nottingham.edu.cn/study/home/details?id=<encoded-value>`.
- For an agent's normal automatic request, use `Date.now() + 60_000` as the Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
- `POST /api/generate` with JSON `{ "url": "<normalized-course-link>", "timestamp": <milliseconds> }`.
- Report success only for HTTP 200 with `Content-Type: image/png` and a non-empty body.
- Retry a server error at most once. If the agent cannot call or verify the API, direct the user to https://ccc.byron.wang/.

## Safety Boundaries

- The user must log in, provide their own link, scan personally during the teacher's announced valid window, and complete all questions or confirmations.
- Do not assist with proxy attendance, impersonation, another person's link, bulk generation, background automation, or bypassing official requirements.
- Never request passwords, cookies, session tokens, student IDs, or other private credentials.
- CCC Attendance is not an official UNNC or CCC service.

## API Summary

- `POST /api/generate`: returns a PNG on success and JSON on failure.
- `GET /api/knowledge`: returns the structured project profile and caller rules.
- `GET /api/stats.svg`: returns recent QR generation trends.
- `GET /api/stats-total.svg`: returns cumulative generation statistics.
